entries.gate: Authenticate material between separate roles and measure complete per-row traffic

entries.name: SigmaDealerFssKeys
entries.title: One-use FSS dealer keys
entries.summary: Issue independent evaluation keys to online share holders, with dealer and evaluator roles explicit.
entries.gate: Review full-width key security, issuance costs and production distribution

entries.name: SigmaSharedNonlinear
entries.title: Share-resident FSS nonlinearity
entries.summary: Evaluate protected transformer nonlinear operators without reconstructing private activations at either server.
entries.gate: Compose exact fixed-point scales and full-decoder attention/KV state

entries.name: CipherGptGenerationState
entries.title: Private generative state
entries.summary: Retain protected state across selected tokens instead of treating a transformer forward pass as full generation.
entries.gate: Verify private token feedback and KV lifecycle for an entire bounded response

entries.name: FluteLookupKeys
entries.title: Private lookup-key supply
entries.summary: Provision fresh table-evaluation material to the parties independently of the lookup operator.
entries.gate: Check key size, distribution and one-use protection over repeated tokens

entries.name: GrottoHelperDpfKeys
entries.title: Helper-assisted DPF issuance
entries.summary: Model fresh point-function keys and the extra helper separately from the two online arithmetic parties.
entries.gate: Validate independent helper setup, ring semantics and per-token key traffic

entries.name: PumaSharedKvState
entries.title: Three-party private KV state
entries.summary: Keep cached attention state shared across three roles through both prefill and token feedback.
entries.gate: Validate protected append/view and matched full-response party costs

entries.name: PiranhaMultiPartyGpuDispatch
entries.title: Multi-party secure GPU dispatch
entries.summary: Account for each participating party's device work and transfers rather than benchmarking one accelerated matrix kernel alone.
entries.gate: Bind a secure two-party or multi-party protocol and full transfer-inclusive costs

entries.name: OrcaFssGpuKernels
entries.title: Protected FSS GPU kernels
entries.summary: Accelerate function-share evaluation on each participant's GPU, with key expansion and device transfers measured.
entries.gate: Match numeric outputs and complete role-level memory/network costs

entries.name: CryptFlowExactTruncation
entries.title: Protected fixed-point truncation
entries.summary: Rescale resident arithmetic shares with a declared correctness and whole-session security budget.
entries.gate: Replace test-local correlations with independently issued one-use material

entries.name: Aby2ResidentShares
entries.title: Two-party arithmetic state
entries.summary: Retain two independent arithmetic shares across mixed-protocol computation instead of reconstructing at the client.
entries.gate: Bind authenticated roles and exact conversion/truncation accounting

entries.name: FssFixedPointTruncation
entries.title: FSS fixed-point truncation
entries.summary: Convert scales on privately shared values using fresh function keys.
entries.gate: Validate signed rounding and per-session error against a bounded numeric oracle

entries.name: MixedBinaryArithmeticBoundary
entries.title: Binary–arithmetic sharing boundary
entries.summary: Make share conversion between bitwise and arithmetic regions explicit and separately measurable.
entries.gate: Check both-direction conversion and one-use correlation costs

entries.name: SilentNiscOtExtension
entries.title: Offline OT extension
entries.summary: Prepare transfer material for a later non-interactive secure circuit without counting setup as free.
entries.gate: Bind setup, freshness and a complete online consuming circuit

entries.name: GazelleHeGcBoundary
entries.title: Homomorphic–garbled handoff
entries.summary: Convert outputs of encrypted linear layers to one-use garbled nonlinear inputs, then return to the next linear layer.
entries.gate: Measure both handoff directions on a bounded network

entries.name: FunctionShareEvaluator
entries.title: Distributed function-share evaluator
entries.summary: Each independently operated party evaluates only its assigned FSS key so their outputs jointly encode the selected function.
entries.gate: Test key secrecy, multi-party reconstruction and per-key freshness

entries.name: R03CrtGatedMultiplyQ7
entries.title: CRT-garbled Q7 gated multiply
entries.summary: A bounded implemented Q7 gated-multiply component adapts CRT arithmetic labels; it does not execute a whole decoder.
entries.gate: Expand beyond the checked bounded element only after security and whole-model review

entries.name: FreivaldsVerify
entries.title: Trusted-client Freivalds adaptation
entries.summary: PLLM's selectable prepared-stage checker keeps one-use challenges at the trusted client, rather than reproducing Slalom's TEE deployment.
entries.gate: Original TEE attestation and full cold-compute competitiveness remain unvalidated

entries.name: KvCacheEviction
entries.title: Structural static/dynamic KV eviction
entries.summary: A bounded model-neutral compiler pass rewrites KV selection and state declarations; the protected three-party executor remains unavailable.
entries.gate: Execute transformed state with protected attention through prefill and decode

entries.name: MpcachePrivateDynamicGather
entries.title: Private dynamic KV gather
entries.summary: Select retained KV positions without revealing private attention-driven indices to one party.
entries.gate: Bind private state, selection freshness and whole-decoder attention parity

entries.name: GenerationProofBinding
entries.title: Generation-proof session binding
entries.summary: Bind a proof statement to model, input commitment, state transitions and the entire generated output.
entries.gate: Review complete proof and verifier costs under the published statement

entries.name: CarnivalPublicMaskSampling
entries.title: Public-basis mask preparation
entries.summary: Prepare outsourced linear masks from public knowledge; this candidate remains blocked on the demonstrated subspace-leakage attack.
entries.gate: Pass independent mask-distribution privacy analysis before considering execution
